北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天晴朗但体感 6℃，风干物燥，记得多喝水，注意保湿哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing, feels like 6℃. It's dry, so stay hydrated and moisturize!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天且体感 3℃，北风 3级，风力不小，多穿暖和点哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and feels like 3℃ with a 3-级 north wind. Bundle up!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷，体感 5℃，湿度较高。出门别忘添衣保暖哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like 5℃. It's damp, so dress warmly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阵雨，湿度 92%，出门记得带伞，别淋湿了哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Showers in Guangzhou, 92% humidity. Don't forget your umbrella!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 15℃，略显潮湿。注意适时添减衣物哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 15℃ and a bit damp. Dress comfortably!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感 2℃，北风 3级。风寒效应强，穿暖和点！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels like 2℃ with a 3-级 north wind. Stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 4℃，略有寒意。记得多穿衣服，以防感冒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels like 4℃. It's chilly, so dress warmly to avoid colds!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天但体感 19℃，很舒适。保持好心情，享受一天！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy but feels like a comfortable 19℃. Enjoy your day!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，注意及时添衣哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature changes, dress accordingly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云但体感 9℃，空气干燥。注意补充水分，保持健康！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is partly cloudy, feels like 9℃ and dry. Remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 16℃，适中。保持愉悦心情，享受生活！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like a pleasant 16℃. Enjoy your day!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -3℃，寒意十足。务必多穿厚衣，严防感冒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -3℃ and very cold. Bundle up to avoid catching a cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾且体感 -4℃，又冷又雾。注意保暖，外出戴口罩！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is hazy and feels like -4℃. It's cold and foggy, wear a mask!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 14℃，风力 3级。风干物燥，注意防风保湿！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 14℃ with a 3-级 wind. It's dry, so stay hydrated!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 10℃，风力 3级。风不小，记得添衣保暖！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 10℃ with a 3-级 wind. Dress warmly!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾且体感 2℃，湿冷。能见度低，出行请注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and feels like 2℃. Low visibility, drive safely!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾且体感 -1℃，湿冷。请注意保暖，小心驾驶！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and feels like -1℃. It's damp and cold, stay warm and drive carefully!
